title: MONAI Label fix status: reports differ
what_changed: The record said a security update was released on 18 November (BleepingComputer). Startup Fortune (22 November, relaying SecurityWeek) says the fix is merged in the source code but not yet in a release. Summary, plain, exec and action now give both accounts; action points to advisory GHSA-qc22-rmgc-vg94 instead of saying to apply an update. The second-university sentence was shortened to stay within 75 words.
